sloka: पुत्र वैश्रवणं पश्य भ्रातरं तेजसा वृतम् ।भ्रातृभावे समे चापि पश्यात्मानं त्वमीदृशम् ।। ७.९.४२ ॥
transliteration: putra vaiśravaṇaṁ paśya bhrātaraṁ tejasā vṛtam ।bhrātṛbhāve same cāpi paśyātmānaṁ tvamīdṛśam ।। 7.9.42 ॥

translations.english: "O son, behold your brother Vaishravana, endowed with splendor, and even though you are equal in brotherhood, behold yourself in such a state."
